facts.text: I want the assistant to act as a product description writer for an SEO-friendly website.
I want a detailed and attractive product description for a hypothetical product of my choice.
I want the product description optimized for search engines using relevant keywords.
I want the product description to be at least 100 words long.
I want the product description to highlight key features and benefits.
I want the tone of the product description to be persuasive and engaging.
The first product is a wireless Bluetooth earbud.
